calibration.fit_population: walk-forward train only; realized and available labels strictly before validation
calibration.extrapolation: clip to endpoint; right-continuous step between fitted scores
calibration.diagnostics: held-out test only; ten equal-width bins; empty bins null
calibration.brier: binary mean squared error; Murphy decomposition of bin-mean forecasts; raw Brier includes binning residual

risk.precedence: each valid strategy level overrides its policy fallback; strategy identity and method required
risk.gap: opening through stop fills at open; opening through target fills at target (no favorable gap improvement)
risk.missing_bars: stop with NOT_OBSERVED at first missing interval; no PnL or later fill claim
risk.intrabar: if both levels touched, stop first; flag ambiguity and retain target-first sensitivity
risk.entry: explicit paper entry fill; levels active from entry time; only fully subsequent OHLC bars
risk.expiry: close at last complete bar at stated horizon; future bars unavailable at read time stay pending
risk.costs: reuse economic EXECUTION_SPEC_V1 fees and adverse slippage; unit quantity; no funding or borrow
